review.posthog_relevance: Supportability and UX for Apple Search Ads warehouse connector configuration
review.reason: The production hunk P1.F1.H1 removes internal implementation details and library-specific references from an error message, retaining only the user-facing instruction. This improves the user experience and supportability of the Apple Search Ads warehouse connector. The test hunk P1.F2.H1 validates this behavior. This is a substantive, bounded improvement in the connector's support,
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to the connector's configuration support and does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or wider architectural changes. No evidence of actual support ticket reduction or incident avoidance is available.
